sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Column filter highlighting no longer misses a match that spans a real comma-separator text node between two linked entities — e.g. filtering an artist's Events tab Location column for a query like "k, n" against a native "place in area, area, area" chain (`Midtown Manhattan, New York, New York, …`) correctly narrowed the row count but left the matching area-link boundary with zero visible highlight spans, even though a same-node match elsewhere in the same cell (inside a plain-text comment) highlighted correctly.
